text: Nightly database backup runs at 02:00 and is kept for 14 days. Restore with the restore-snapshot procedure.
Restore-snapshot procedure: stop writers, pick a snapshot by timestamp, restore to a scratch database, verify row counts, then swap.
TLS certificates renew automatically 30 days before expiry. If renewal fails, the expiry alarm fires 7 days out.
Disk usage alarm fires at 85 percent. First check log rotation, then old build artifacts, then temp upload folders.
Log rotation keeps 7 compressed daily files per service. Rotation failures usually mean a full disk or a permissions change.
Deploys run from the main branch after tests pass. A deploy can be rolled back by redeploying the previous build.
Rollback: find the last green build, redeploy it, then confirm the version endpoint reports the old build id.
If the job queue backs up, check for one long-running job starving the workers before adding more workers.
Cache keys expire after one hour. Purging the whole cache during peak traffic causes a load spike on the database.
DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate. Lower the record TTL a day before a planned migration.
API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per key. Bursts above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a retry-after header.
On-call rotation changes every Monday at 09:00. Escalate to the secondary after 15 minutes without acknowledgement.
Secrets live in the secrets manager, never in the repository. Rotate a leaked key first, then purge it from history.
Schema migrations run before the new code starts. Destructive migrations require a two-step expand then contract rollout.
Memory alarm at 90 percent. Look for a worker that never releases memory; restarting the worker is the short-term fix.
Build hosts must not sleep. A sleeping host silently stops running scheduled jobs until someone wakes it.
Every scheduled job writes a heartbeat. A separate monitor alarms when a heartbeat is older than twice the schedule interval.
A flaky test is quarantined with an owner and a ticket, never deleted. Quarantine expires after 14 days.
Monthly cloud cost review compares spend to the budget; any service growing more than 20 percent month over month gets a ticket.
Search index rebuild takes about 40 minutes. Queries during a rebuild read the previous index until the swap.
